messages.text: Any coupon code for check out

No discount codes on our side, sorry. Prices on the site are the price.

If you want, I'll pass it to Georges and he can have the final say. In the meantime, happy to help you pick the right unit. Were you looking at the Harlo B30?
yes
Read the bsb b30 page
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30

Good pick. The B30 is $899, 30 TH/s at 485 W on Turbo, about 50 dB, WiFi or ethernet, power supply built in. It's a pre-sale unit: ships October 30, 2026.

Here it is: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/bsb-b30

Where will it run, and roughly what do you pay per kWh? I'll run the real numbers for your area before you buy.
What OS does the Harlo B30 ship with?

It ships with Harlo OS, our own firmware, preloaded. You get a web dashboard on your local network for pool setup, the three power modes (Turbo, Balanced, ECO), temps and hashrate. Updates come over the air.

Downloads, release notes and guides live at https://harlolabs.com/ if you want a look before you buy.

Anything else you want to check, or shall I get you to checkout?
What chips does the Magic Miner vs B30
Searched the catalog · Magic Miner 40T

Different generations. The B30 runs the newer BM1373 chips; the Magic Miner 40T runs 30× BM1370.

In practice: B30 is 30 TH/s at 485 W (16.2 J/TH Turbo), $899, ships October 30. Magic Miner 40T is 40 TH/s at ~650 W (~16 J/TH), $799, ships November 14, and it's solo mining to your own node.

Similar efficiency. More hashrate for less money on the 40T, more power draw. Which matters more to you?
Number of chips per unit

Magic Miner 40T: 30× BM1370, stated on the listing.

The B30 listing doesn't give a chip count, only the BM1373 chip type, so I won't guess. I'll get the exact number confirmed for you.

Want me to pass that one to the team, or does the hashrate and wattage settle it for you?
find out chip count on the B30
Opened a product
Handed to the team · B30 listing and catalog record do not state a chip count; will not guess a spec.

The B30 listing only names the chip (BM1373) and doesn't publish a count, so I'd be guessing, and I won't do that on a spec.

I've put the question to the team. They pick it up today at 10am ET and the answer comes to (email hidden)

What I can tell you now: 30 TH/s at 485 W Turbo, 16.2 J/TH, built-in 540 W supply, about 50 dB. Ships October 30.
The B30 has 6 chips

Could well be, but I can't confirm it from anything I have, so I won't put our name behind it. The team will come back with the real number today.

Either way it doesn't change what the unit does: 30 TH/s at 485 W, 16.2 J/TH, about 50 dB.

Where are you planning to run it, and roughly what do you pay per kWh? I'll work out what it actually stacks for you.
Does the Magic Miner ship with harlo OS?

The listing doesn't say Harlo OS for the Magic Miner, so I won't claim it. Harlo OS is the firmware on our Harlo and Hammer units. What the 40T page does state is solo mining pointed at your own node and your own address.

I've added it to the question already with the team, so you'll get both answers together today.
Will the Harlo H15 ship with Harlo OS?

Yes. The Harlo Duo Pack listing states both Harlo machines run Harlo OS, so the H15 Dual ships with it, same dashboard and power modes as the B30.

The H15 Dual is $799, 15 TH/s on Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s Scrypt for Dogecoin and Litecoin, ~500 W, about 50 dB: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/harlo-h15-dual

Are you leaning toward mining Doge alongside Bitcoin, or pure Bitcoin?
both

Then the H15 Dual on its own does both, $799, 15 TH/s Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s Scrypt, ~500 W.

If you want more Bitcoin alongside it, the Harlo Duo Pack is the B30 and the H15 together at $1,599, listed at $1,698 separately. Combined draw is about 985 W, so a dedicated outlet and roughly 100 dB of two fans in one room.

Start with just the H15, or go for the pair?
Just the H15
